Chow Tai Fook DAWN Collection

INTRODUCING DAWN. Inspired by the timeless Chinese four-petal flower motif, the new DAWN Collection embodies self-expression and radiant beginnings. CHOW TAI FOOK has told stories of self-discovery through craft, defining what it means to be true to yourself. DAWN continues this legacy, transforming tradition into a language of individuality. DAWN. THE COURAGE TO BE YOU. Director: @audreymascina Art director: @2x4design Producer: @terryjinproduction 呈獻「萬相系列」 靈感來自歷久彌新的中國四瓣花圖騰，「萬相系列」如同破曉晨光，詮釋真我個性。品牌自創立以來，致力以匠心工藝承載每一段自我探索的故事，塑造獨一無二的風格。系列延續這份品牌精髓 ， 將傳統圖騰轉化為當代美學的設計語言，展現自信與最真實的自己。 以真我個性成就圓滿。 導演：@audreymascina 美術指導：@2x4design 製作：@terryjinproduction #ChowTaiFook #DawnCollection#萬相系列#TheCourageToBeYou
